column1: # requirements/vanth.wheels.tsv - the reviewed record of the wheel behind every hash in requirements/vanth.lock. One row per pin.
# Columns, separated by a tab: name, version, wheel file, platform tag, sha256 of that wheel file.
# Generated 2026-10-28 from the artifacts themselves: each wheel the lock's `# wheel:` comment names was downloaded from PyPI and
# hashed. The hash is the same as PyPI's own digest for that file and as the lock's, for all rows. The platform tag is the last
# part of the wheel file name (any, or macosx_<major>_<minor>_arm64 / universal2).
# tests/test_velo_task.sh (t_lock_file) requires every hash in the lock to equal the sha256 here for its pin, with the
# same wheel file name, and every row to have its pin. A hash that is not of the named wheel (an sdist's, say, under a wheel's
# comment) therefore cannot enter the lock without a change to this file as well. An upgrade changes both in one reviewed commit.
